title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: When is your birthday? It's on May 20th.
sentences.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？是五月二十日。

sentences.en: Let's have a surprise party for him.
sentences.zh: 我们给他办一个惊喜派对吧。

sentences.en: Make a wish and blow out the candles.
How much is the cake? It's thirty yuan.
We celebrate National Day on October 1st.
sentences.zh: 我们在十月一日庆祝国庆节。

sentences.en: I'll take two kilos of apples.
This is the best birthday ever!
sentences.zh: 这是我过得最好的生日！
